findings.label: Dead ProductPage component
findings.description: src/components/products/ProductPage.tsx exports a full reusable page layout that is not imported by any file in the project. Either wire it into AgriInputsProductPage as intended, or delete it to avoid confusion.

findings.label: Invalid-slug redirect vs. 404
findings.description: AgriInputsProductPage redirects to /products/agri-inputs on an unrecognised slug instead of showing a not-found page. This differs from the source behaviour (Next.js notFound()) and silently drops users on the listing page with no explanation. Acceptable for a CSR app but should be a deliberate decision.
